name: Build GorillaPatcher APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install Apktool and Build Tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y apktool default-jdk

      - name: Prepare GorillaPatcher Structure and Config
        run: |
          mkdir -p output_project/assets/bin/Managed
          
          if [ ! -f "output_project/apktool.yml" ]; then
            echo 'version: "2.7.0"' > output_project/apktool.yml
            echo 'apkFileName: GorillaPatcher.apk' >> output_project/apktool.yml
            echo 'isFrameworkApk: false' >> output_project/apktool.yml
            echo 'packageInfo:' >> output_project/apktool.yml
            echo '  forcedPackageId: "127"' >> output_project/apktool.yml
            echo '  renameManifestPackage: "com.TvMods.GorillaPatcher"' >> output_project/apktool.yml
          fi

          if [ ! -f "output_project/AndroidManifest.xml" ]; then
            echo '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" standalone="no"?>' > output_project/AndroidManifest.xml
            echo '<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" package="com.AnotherAxiom.GorillaTag" platformBuildVersionCode="32" platformBuildVersionName="12">' >> output_project/AndroidManifest.xml
            echo '    <application android:allowBackup="false" android:appComponentFactory="androidx.core.app.CoreComponentFactory" android:debuggable="true" android:label="Gorilla Tag">' >> output_project/AndroidManifest.xml
            echo '    </application>' >> output_project/AndroidManifest.xml
            echo '</manifest>' >> output_project/AndroidManifest.xml
          fi

      - name: Compile GorillaPatcher APK
        run: |
          echo "Building APK for com.AnotherAxiom.GorillaTag using GorillaPatcher..."
          mkdir -p build/outputs
          apktool b output_project -o build/outputs/GorillaPatcher.apk

      - name: Sign APK with Debug Key
        run: |
          # Non-interactive key generation to prevent prompt freezing/failures
          keytool -genkey -v -keystore debug.keystore -alias androiddebugkey -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -storepass android -keypass android -dname "CN=Android Debug, O=Android, C=US"
          jarsigner -verbose -sigalg SHA256withRSA -digestalg SHA-256 -keystore debug.keystore -storepass android build/outputs/GorillaPatcher.apk androiddebugkey

      - name: Upload GorillaPatcher Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: GorillaPatcher-APK
          path: build/outputs/GorillaPatcher.apk
